scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build:client && npm run tooling:check && npm run test:unit
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env dev
scripts.db:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env dev
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.db:list:local: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --local --env dev
scripts.db:list:dev: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote --env dev
scripts.db:list:staging: wrangler d1 migrations list DB --remote --env staging
scripts.predeploy:prod: npm run build:client && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/security-preflight.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/operations-preflight.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
